findings.finding: Adult-only cues are inconsistent across duplicated actions; recipe 15 panels 5–6 both depict air-fryer cooking but only one is labeled. Recipe 15 panels 3–4 also differ on the raw-egg/crumb step.
Shared source step wording and visual actions require panel-level reconciliation. Recipe 11 panel 1 appears to show washing while its shared source text also mentions adult cucumber cutting.
Repeated or abstract pictograms leave action progression unclear; adjacent duplicate panels do not always show a clear change.

The batch is primarily geometric utensil/food art and does not show the established original cartoon characters. Source step text and SVG descriptions are English-only; bilingual adult badges do not provide equivalent PT-BR instructions.

note: Independent read-only review reports are evidence of findings, not A08/A09 formal approvals. No automated check establishes artwork rights.
